free_tier.stated: No free tier: the Service is prepaid, credit is bought by card and there is no free trial. The first Small or Large instance running Mue receives a one-time promotional credit worth 5 days of its running price. Mue on Small or Large credits the first 5 days of hosting to the wallet.
free_tier.notes: The 5-day credit is a one-time new-account promotion, not a recurring allowance, and requires buying credit by card. Mue must be chosen on Small or Large.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: the unit is a machine, not an object; the Small size has 5 GB of NVMe storage and a versioned workspace with a file explorer

retention.stated: An agent whose balance stays at zero or below for 3 days is stopped, not deleted, and restarts after adding credit; instances keep being charged while they exist. Deleting the agent ends the charge.

egress.terms: $0 network fees, in or out; a public HTTPS address is included with every agent

interface_detail: A terminal in the browser, SSH access, the API and a public HTTPS address for every agent.
tooling: Console, SSH, API and a public HTTPS address; the instance runs the vendor's agent runtime with automatic repair and a versioned workspace.
chaining: An always-on hosted agent with its own public HTTPS URL; a job that must survive instance deletion needs its output copied to a separate object-storage record.

limits.value: Small $2.88 per month, billed by the day and prorated to the time the agent exists; stopped workspace about 10x cheaper; $0 once the agent is deleted
Small: up to 1.5 vCPU, up to 1.5 GB RAM, 5 GB NVMe storage

limits_note: Billing is prepaid by card; when the balance reaches zero, tools stop, and after 3 days at zero or below instances are stopped but keep being charged until deleted.
binding_note: The prepaid balance and the $2.88 a month running price are what run out first; the 5 GB disk and 1.5 GB RAM of the Small tier cap a job before any count-based limit does.

identity_cost.detail: The signup form asks for region, organization, your name, a work email and a website, plus agreement to the Terms and Acceptable Use Policy. The Terms require email confirmation and state that credit is bought by card through Stripe with no free trial.

reliability_note: No service level applies unless a separate signed agreement says so; tools stop when prepaid credit reaches zero, and instances are stopped after 3 days at zero or below.
confidence_note: The price, included resources, no-fee egress and signup fields come from the vendor's pricing and signup pages read 2026-11-25; the prepaid card requirement, the one-time 5-day credit and the stop behaviour come from the vendor's terms page read the same day.
